title.zh: v2rayN Windows 最新版从零精通：核心引擎切换（Xray / sing-box）与基础节点管理
title.en: Mastering v2rayN on Windows: Core Switching (Xray / sing-box) & Advanced Node Management

description.zh: 面向 Windows 用户的 2026 v2rayN 深度使用指南。详解 Xray-core 与 sing-box 核心自由切换、订阅解析、批量真机延迟与下载速度测速、自定义快捷键与系统托盘常驻调优。
description.en: In-depth guide to v2rayN for Windows. Learn how to switch between Xray-core and sing-box engines, manage encrypted subscription pools, execute batch true-latency speedtests, and configure system tray behaviors.
